MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The clamp meter fits my interest in diagnosing repair problems alongside my inspection camera, caliper, and infrared thermometer.",
    "The quick-setting glue, scuff pads, and rectangular magnets support practical repair work: bonding small parts, preparing surfaces, and making removable fixtures alongside my existing epoxy and fasteners."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The breadboards assume I am building electronic circuits, while my recent tools and supplies point more toward mechanical repairs and fabrication.",
    "The wide gaffers tape does not address a current need, and a bulk pack of five-inch deck screws is too specific without an outdoor project requiring that length and quantity.",
    "The acrylic sheets, small magnets, and pegboard are plausible interests, but I would need matching dimensions, holding strength, or mounting capacity before choosing them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning workshop tools seems to have been stretched into an interest in any DIY supply, even when its actual use differs from my current work.",
    "My purchases of tape and assorted fasteners seem to have been treated as reasons to suggest more tape and screws without enough attention to their particular purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Complementary steps matter to me: surface preparation supports my adhesive and resin work, and removable fixtures offer another useful way to secure parts.",
    "My repeated purchases of fastener assortments suggest that having useful sizes available matters; a large quantity of one unusually long screw does not serve the same need.",
    "A tool or material can fit my workshop interests without being something I need now; project dimensions and practical requirements determine whether I would choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my repair and fabrication interests, but sometimes confused broad workshop relevance with a concrete next need."
}
